## claude.ai Claude Docs
Claude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai …/artifact/… link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. <?claude block asof?> · <?claude block me?>

<?claude block s1?>

<?claude block s2?>"}}}, batch = [] )` (`<?claude block k?>` ↔ `blocks.k`); its ack links the doc → `open` it with your Artifact tool (none → start your next message with the link, once); they're likely watching it fill — keep them posted in a short line naming what you're on (outline up; now <topic>); findings go in the doc, not chat; then `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )`, research, and fill each section: `replace` its pending id with `## <heading>` + body; end with one line + the link, never the document. package org.commcare.fragments.personalId

/**
 * Launch context for the PersonalID email entry / verification screens.
 *
 *  - [REGISTRATION]: brand-new signup.
 *  - [RECOVERY]: existing user recovering their account after validating the backup code.
 *  - [EXISTING_USER]: a logged-in user adding or verifying their email post-registration.
 *  - [FORGOT_BACKUP_CODE_RECOVERY]: account config graph — user forgot backup code, verifying
 *    via email OTP to complete recovery (session token auth). On OTP success, calls
 *    `complete_recovery` then routes to set-new-backup-code.
 *  - [FORGOT_BACKUP_CODE_EXISTING_USER]: profile graph — logged-in user forgot backup code,
 *    verifying via email OTP to be allowed to set a new backup code.
 *  - [PENDING_BACKUP_CODE]: for the pending-backup-code flow — user has no backup code yet.
 */
enum class EmailWorkFlow {
    REGISTRATION,
    RECOVERY,
    EXISTING_USER,
    FORGOT_BACKUP_CODE_RECOVERY,
    FORGOT_BACKUP_CODE_EXISTING_USER,
    PENDING_BACKUP_CODE,
}

<navigation xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools"
    android:id="@+id/nav_graph_personalid_profile"
    app:startDestination="@id/personalid_profile_fragment">

    <fragment
        android:id="@+id/personalid_profile_fragment"
        android:name="org.commcare.personalId.profile.PersonalIdProfileFragment"
        android:label="@string/personalid_profile_title">
        <action
            android:id="@+id/action_profile_to_profile_edit"
            app:destination="@id/personalid_profile_edit_fragment" />
        <action
            android:id="@+id/action_profile_to_profile_backup_code"
            app:destination="@id/personalid_profile_backup_code_fragment" />
        <action
            android:id="@+id/action_profile_to_send_email_otp"
            app:destination="@id/personalid_send_email_otp_fragment" />
    </fragment>

    <fragment
        android:id="@+id/personalid_profile_edit_fragment"
        android:name="org.commcare.personalId.profile.PersonalIdProfileEditFragment"
        android:label="@string/personalid_profile_edit_title">
        <action
            android:id="@+id/action_profile_edit_to_backup_code"
            app:destination="@id/personalid_profile_backup_code_fragment" />
    </fragment>

    <fragment
        android:id="@+id/personalid_email_verification_fragment"
        android:name="org.commcare.fragments.personalId.PersonalIdProfileEmailVerificationFragment"
        android:label="@string/personalid_email_verification_appbar_title"
        tools:layout="@layout/fragment_personalid_email_verification">
        <argument
            android:name="email"
            app:argType="string" />
        <argument
            android:name="workflow"
            app:argType="org.commcare.fragments.personalId.EmailWorkFlow" />
        <argument
            android:name="emailOtpRequestCount"
            app:argType="integer" />
    </fragment>

    <fragment
        android:id="@+id/personalid_email_verification_forgot_backup_code_fragment"
        android:name="org.commcare.fragments.personalId.PersonalIdEmailVerificationForgotBackupCodeFragment"
        android:label="@string/personalid_email_verification_appbar_title"
        tools:layout="@layout/fragment_personalid_email_verification">
        <argument
            android:name="email"
            app:argType="string" />
        <argument
            android:name="emailOtpRequestCount"
            app:argType="integer" />
        <action
            android:id="@+id/action_email_verification_forgot_backup_code_to_set_new_backup_code"
            app:destination="@id/personalid_profile_set_new_backup_code_fragment"
            app:popUpTo="@id/personalid_profile_fragment"
            app:popUpToInclusive="false" />
    </fragment>

    <fragment
        android:id="@+id/personalid_profile_backup_code_fragment"
        android:name="org.commcare.personalId.profile.PersonalIdProfileBackupCodeFragment"
        android:label="@string/connect_backup_code_title_confirm">
        <argument
            android:name="pendingEmail"
            app:argType="string"
            android:defaultValue="" />
        <argument
            android:name="emailWorkflow"
            app:argType="org.commcare.fragments.personalId.EmailWorkFlow"
            android:defaultValue="FORGOT_BACKUP_CODE_EXISTING_USER" />
        <action
            android:id="@+id/action_profile_backup_code_to_set_new_backup_code"
            app:destination="@id/personalid_profile_set_new_backup_code_fragment" />
        <action
            android:id="@+id/action_profile_backup_code_to_send_email_otp"
            app:destination="@id/personalid_send_email_otp_fragment" />
    </fragment>

    <fragment
        android:id="@+id/personalid_send_email_otp_fragment"
        android:name="org.commcare.fragments.personalId.PersonalIdProfileSendEmailOtpFragment">
        <argument
            android:name="email"
            app:argType="string" />
        <argument
            android:name="masked"
            app:argType="boolean"
            android:defaultValue="true" />
        <argument
            android:name="workflow"
            app:argType="org.commcare.fragments.personalId.EmailWorkFlow" />
        <action
            android:id="@+id/action_personalid_send_email_otp_to_email_verification_forgot_backup_code"
            app:destination="@id/personalid_email_verification_forgot_backup_code_fragment" />
        <action
            android:id="@+id/action_personalid_send_email_otp_to_profile_email_verification"
            app:destination="@id/personalid_email_verification_fragment" />
    </fragment>

    <fragment
        android:id="@+id/personalid_profile_set_new_backup_code_fragment"
        android:name="org.commcare.personalId.profile.PersonalIdProfileSetNewBackupCodeFragment"
        android:label="@string/personalid_set_new_backup_code_title" />

</navigation>
